# proxmox_storage_file_restore_download (Data Source)

Downloads a file from a file-restore snapshot through `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/file-restore/download`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_storage_file_restore_download" "d" {
  node     = "pve-1"
  storage  = "backup"
  volume   = "backup:backup/vzdump-qemu-300-2026_01_01-00_00_00.vma.zst"
  filepath = "/etc/hostname"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filepath` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `volume` (String)

### Optional

- `tar` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `content` (String)
